app.name: Screen camera
app.summary: The screen's own camera in Home Assistant, as live video with sound or as pictures, and the room's light level and motion from it.
app.setting_sensing_hint: The camera measures the room's light and notices movement, on the screen itself: no picture leaves it for this. The camera stays on while this is on.
app.setting_upside_down_hint: Turns the camera's picture half way round, for a screen mounted the other way up from how it is built. The pictures, the video and the light level and motion all follow.
app.setting_wake_hint: With light level and motion on, someone moving in front of the screen wakes it, as a touch does.
app.setting_time_out_hint: How long Motion stays on after the last movement: a few seconds for someone walking past, minutes to tell an empty room.
app.part_video_hint: Live video with sound in Home Assistant, as a camera Video on the screen's device. The camera then runs from the start; its pictures come from the video. Install Video in Home Assistant once under Tessera's Settings.
